==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
In this world, I have a daughter despite having no children in the waking world. She is a small girl around the age of four. She has light brown skin, brown eyes, black hair in a pigtails hairstyle, and she always wears a purple shirt and purple pants. 

She carries with her a mysterious baby doll that has a light brown color, a white diaper, and a large white tulip for a head. She says that the doll helps her sleep by entering her dreams. I don't like the doll, as it does seem to have strange abilities that I don't fully understand.

I mysteriously acquire a large fortune, that I feel I've earned despite not recognizing where the money came from. Almost immediately, I tell my daughter that she can now sleep in everyday and that she doesn't need her doll anymore. I put her paranormal doll into storage and it splits into a normal baby doll and a large white tulip.
